pick_reasons: 2611.33402 (partial routing) comes first. It is a concrete method for people building agents: a lead model delegates subtasks to a cheaper worker, guided by what past runs show. Its numbers are easy to follow and can be checked against the paper: ViBench 70.2 to 78.5 at 19% lower cost, and Terminal-Bench pass rate 54% to 61% at similar cost. The runners-up are also agent or LLM-system papers with measurable results: MGMem (agent memory without generative indexing), the information-theoretic study of what LLM agents must communicate, the negative result on memory-collapse predictors (805 snaps…
